question: Can the UPLB 2012 Mount Makiling biodiversity-assessment report supply fish taxa or waterbody-resolved fish evidence from accessible sources?

repositoryRecord.provider: University of the Philippines Los Baños Knowledge Digital Repository
repositoryRecord.title: Biodiversity assessment of Mt. Makiling Forest Reserve
repositoryRecord.availabilityStatement: The repository page says the document is currently not available here.
repositoryRecord.recommendedCitation: Macandog, Damasa M. (2012). Biodiversity assessment of Mt. Makiling Forest Reserve. UPLB Knowledge Digital Repository, Report 832.

secondaryAbstractRecord.provider: FAO AGRIS; record supplied by University of the Philippines at Los Baños
secondaryAbstractRecord.title: Biodiversity assessment of Mt.Makiling Forest Reserve [Los Baños, Laguna, Philippines]
secondaryAbstractRecord.scope: Abstract describes microbial, floral, and faunal surveys along elevational gradients of the UPLB Forestry slope on the northeastern side of Mt. Makiling.
secondaryAbstractRecord.makibisFinding: The abstract says the Makiling Biodiversity Database (MAKIBIS) was created to organize biology and ecology information from the assessment.

accessAndRights.decision: Keep only attributed metadata and a concise scope summary. The report, appendices, maps, tables, photographs, and any structured taxa are not redistributed.

decision.reason: The accessible record and provider-supplied abstract describe a multi-group biodiversity assessment but provide no fish names, fish counts, fish methods, or waterbody-level fish results. The full terminal report is unavailable in the repository, so its unreviewed contents cannot be ruled in or out.

limitations: The abstract's omission of fish is not a fish-absence result and does not establish that the full terminal report contains no fish information.
The UPLB item record lists Macandog as author, while the AGRIS record lists 21 contributors; the underlying report was unavailable to reconcile the bibliographic detail.
No fish sampling method, collection date, station, waterbody, coordinate, voucher, photo, taxon identity, or reuse term was verified.
nextAction: Use the UPLB item only as a retrieval lead; rely on separately verified fish surveys or reusable occurrence records for Makiling streams and rivers unless an authorized full copy is later available.
